note: What refresh-safe.sh accepts as a known failure. A gating checker (run-checks.py CHECKS minus REPORT_ONLY) may fail only if it is listed here AND every error line it prints (FAIL / STALE / ISSUE) matches one of its `known` patterns (Python regex, re.search). Anything else is a NEW failure and the refresh is not merged. Report-only checkers (check-bindings and the others in run-checks.py REPORT_ONLY) never gate, so they are not listed. Remove an entry when its failure is fixed; never widen a pattern to let a new failure through. Also judged: refresh.sh's closing tools/ coverage block (refresh_tools_coverage).
